Best Qi2.2 magnetic power banks (November 2026)

All three support 25W magnetic wireless charging and have 10,000mAh capacity.

My pick: Get the Baseus AM52 if it's around $55–$65. Pay extra for the Anker if you prioritize cooling and sustained charging speed.

One important detail: Qi2.2's full 25W requires a compatible phone. Older iPhones generally top out at 15W.

Which iPhone do you have — 16, 17, 18, or something else? That could change which power bank I'd recommend.
